description: This file defines a Lua function 'Head' that generates HTML head elements based on provided properties. It includes meta tags, links to stylesheets, scripts for syntax highlighting, and other HTML head components, mainly for web page layout customization.

methods.name: Head
methods.description: Constructs HTML head elements based on properties like purpose, page_name, media, meta, scripts, and global configurations. Handles different purposes such as 'homepage', 'reference', 'symbol', 'module', and 'editor', adding appropriate scripts, styles, and metadata.
